::: proof

$$
\ba
\deriv{\vcoef} (\vx \cdot \vcoef)
&=
\begin{bmatrix}
\deriv{\coef{1}}(x_1\coef{1}+x_2\coef{2} +...+x_p \coef{p} ) \\
\deriv{\coef{2}}(x_1\coef{1}+x_2\coef{2} +...+x_p \coef{p} ) \\
\vdots \\
\deriv{\coef{p}}(x_1\coef{1}+x_2\coef{2} +...+x_p \coef{p} )
\end{bmatrix}
\\ &=
\begin{bmatrix}
x_{1} \\
x_{2} \\
\vdots \\
x_{p}
\end{bmatrix}
\\ &= \vx
\ea
$$

:::
